import pprint
from pyspark.sql.types import *
import json
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, explode
from pyspark.sql import DataFrame
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
import pyspark.sql.utils

import pandas as pd
from pyspark.sql import Row

# ==================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ==================================================
excel_file = "abfss://odw-config@pinsstodwdevuks9h80mb.dfs.core.windows.net/CrownDevDataDictionaries.xlsx"

table_mappings = [
    ("Standardised", "sb_notify_email", "odw_standardised_db.sb_applications_notify_email"),
    ("Standardised", "sb_representation", "odw_standardised_db.sb_applications_representation"),
    ("Harmonised", "notify_email", "odw_harmonised_db.applications_notify_email"),
    ("Harmonised", "representation", "odw_harmonised_db.applications_representation"),
    ("Harmonised", "representation_document", "odw_harmonised_db.applications_representation_document"),
    ("Curated", "notify_email_fact", "odw_curated_db.applications_notify_email_fact"),
    ("Curated", "representation_fact", "odw_curated_db.applications_representation_fact"),
    ("Curated", "representation_document_fact", "odw_curated_db.applications_representation_document_fact")
]

# ==================================================
# COPY EXCEL LOCALLY
# ==================================================
mssparkutils.fs.cp(
    excel_file,
    "file:/tmp/Crown_Dev_Data_Dictionaries.xlsx",
    True
)

# ==================================================
# LOAD EXCEL SHEETS ONCE
# ==================================================
excel_sheets = {}

for sheet_name in set(x[0] for x in table_mappings):
    excel_sheets[sheet_name] = pd.read_excel(
        "/tmp/Crown_Dev_Data_Dictionaries.xlsx",
        sheet_name=sheet_name
    )

# ==================================================
# COMPARE ALL TABLES
# ==================================================
results = []

for sheet_name, dictionary_table_name, spark_table_name in table_mappings:

    try:
        pdf = excel_sheets[sheet_name]

        # Excel Columns
        excel_columns = set(
            pdf.loc[
                pdf["Table Name"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
                == dictionary_table_name.lower(),
                "Attribute Name"
            ]
            .dropna()
            .astype(str)
            .str.strip()
            .str.lower()
        )

        # Spark Table Columns
        table_columns = set(
            c.lower()
            for c in spark.table(spark_table_name).columns
        )

        # Mismatches Only
        missing = sorted(excel_columns - table_columns)
        extra = sorted(table_columns - excel_columns)

        for col in missing:
            results.append(Row(
                sheet_name=sheet_name,
                dictionary_table_name=dictionary_table_name,
                spark_table_name=spark_table_name,
                column_name=col,
                status="MISSING_IN_TABLE"
            ))

        for col in extra:
            results.append(Row(
                sheet_name=sheet_name,
                dictionary_table_name=dictionary_table_name,
                spark_table_name=spark_table_name,
                column_name=col,
                status="EXTRA_IN_TABLE"
            ))

        print(
            f"{spark_table_name} | Missing={len(missing)} | Extra={len(extra)}"
        )

    except Exception as e:
        results.append(Row(
            sheet_name=sheet_name,
            dictionary_table_name=dictionary_table_name,
            spark_table_name=spark_table_name,
            column_name=None,
            status=f"ERROR: {str(e)}"
        ))

# ==================================================
# DISPLAY ONLY MISMATCHES
# ==================================================
if results:
    mismatch_df = spark.createDataFrame(results)
    display(
        mismatch_df.orderBy(
            "sheet_name",
            "dictionary_table_name",
            "status",
            "column_name"
        )
    )
else:
    print("✅ No mismatches found. All tables match the data dictionary.")
